description: Queries that must run successfully against superstore.db (regression / CI without LLM).

queries.name: count_orders
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders

queries.name: sum_revenue
queries.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(Sales), 0), 2) AS rev FROM Order_Items

queries.name: revenue_by_category
queries.sql: SELECT p.Category AS c, ROUND(SUM(oi.Sales), 2) AS r FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Products p ON oi.Product_Key = p.Product_Key GROUP BY p.Category

queries.name: saved_report_smoke
queries.sql: SELECT p.Category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.Sales), 2) AS revenue FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Products p ON oi.Product_Key = p.Product_Key GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY revenue DESC
